Refresh **http://maker:4001** — each link now shows a **"To read"** or **"Read"** badge, and there's a new **All / To read / Read** switch above the topics.

**This is flow 4 — tracking what you still want to read.** Please try:

1. Click **To read** in the new switch — the list narrows to just your reading queue. Notice a few of the samples are already marked read.
2. On any "to read" link, click **Mark as read** at the bottom of the entry. Watch its badge flip to "Read" and, since you're viewing the queue, it drops out of the "To read" list.
3. Click **Read** to see the ones you've finished; on one of those, click **Move back to "to read"** to send it back to the queue.
4. Save a brand-new link and notice it arrives marked **"To read"** automatically.

What I decided here — please check each:

- **A newly saved link starts as "To read"** — the assumption being you save things mainly to read later.
- **You mark something read yourself, by clicking "Mark as read."** I did *not* make it auto-mark when you open the link — I thought you'd want control over that. Tell me if you'd actually prefer opening a link to mark it read automatically.
- **Read links stay in your collection** (just dimmed with a "Read" badge) rather than disappearing — so your searching and topics still cover them.

Does this give you a dependable way to keep track of what's still to read — and is marking-as-read by hand the right call, or would you want opening the link to do it?
